flags.reason: PRF is stated as '250 kHz', an unusually high value for a pulse repetition frequency (typically Hz-range in tFUS protocols); recorded literally as stated rather than corrected, since the units cannot be verified from the text.
The two tFUS-exposed subgroups received different numbers of real-stimulation sessions (STS: 10 days; LTS: 50 days), so both values are recorded as a list rather than a single number.
n_subjects (16) is the combined Experimental Group (STS+LTS) that received real LIFU stimulation at some point; the Sham Group (n=8) never received active stimulation and is excluded.

readout_other: mRNA microarray (Affymetrix Rat Genome 230 2.0 Array); miRNA qPCR array and real-time PCR validation; anti-MAP2 and anti-JNK1 immunohistochemistry; TUNEL apoptosis assay
direction_notes: LIFU targeted to NAc altered mRNA (454 genes in STS, 382 in LTS vs sham) and miRNA expression (both up- and down-regulated), with more pronounced/different changes after long-term (50-day) vs short-term (10-day) stimulation; this reflects molecular/gene-expression change rather than a measured excitatory or inhibitory shift in neural activity.
safety_notes: No positive cells were seen in the NAc region using anti-JNK1 immunohistochemistry and TUNEL, and no significant differences in anti-MAP2 staining density were found between groups, indicating LIFU did not cause tissue damage or apoptosis.

exposures.label: LIFU to bilateral nucleus accumbens (NAc) in high alcohol-preferring rats

device.model: custom 10-element 1D array (2.4 MHz, dual simultaneous NAc targeting)

timing.protocol_description: Rats were anesthetized and received daily 30-min sessions (EG: 10 or 50 days depending on subgroup; sham group 50 days). Ultrasound parameters: PRF 250 kHz, duty cycle 50%, sonification duration 300 ms, delay 1700 ms, Isppa 4.06 W/cm2, Ispta 305 mW/cm2. STS received 10 days of real LIFU followed by 40 days of sham; LTS received 50 days of real LIFU; the sham group received 50 days of sham stimulation (kept in the device without stimulation).
